news.analysis: With Brock Bowers inactive, Bech led Las Vegas with eight receptions and accounted for a third of Fernando Mendoza's passing yards. It'll be interesting to see if Bech can sustain this level of involvement once Bowers returns. The second-year receiver is worth adding off waivers.
